name: How long does a bathroom remodeling project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodeling project varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A small cosmetic update, such as painting and fixture replacement, might take 1-2 weeks. A complete renovation involving layout changes, new plumbing, and extensive tile work can range from 3-6 weeks. Custom designs or projects requiring special order materials may extend this timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation and design phase.
